primary_heading.usage: H1, H2, large display numbers, hero text. Must have tracking-tight to represent precise military/aviation aesthetic.

body.usage: Paragraphs, navigation, forms, card descriptions. Clean and highly legible substitute for Myriad Pro.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter uppercase text-[#071A2F]

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Strict grid alignment for an authoritative, disciplined feel. Use bento layouts for data-heavy sections like Activities.

grids.activities: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 md:gap-8

surface_strategies.cards: Flat solid surfaces with crisp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-sm). 1px border-[#EAF5F8] with subtle shadow-sm on hover. Never use heavy, muddy shadows.
surface_strategies.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-none). Primary CTA: bg-[#C60C30] text-white hover:bg-[#A00926]. Secondary: bg-[#002F5F] text-white hover:bg-[#071A2F]. Outline: border-2 border-[#002F5F] text-[#002F5F] hover:bg-[#002F5F] hover:text-white.
surface_strategies.header: Solid White or Glassmorphism (bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md) with crisp border-b border-gray-100.
surface_strategies.footer: Dark Navy background (#071A2F) with White and Slate text.

graphic_elements.roundel: Use as a large, subtle watermarked background element (opacity-5 to opacity-10) in corners of cards or section backgrounds. Do not distort or recolor.
graphic_elements.swoosh: Use as an asymmetrical curve divider between light and dark sections. Should feel aviation-inspired, sweeping gracefully.
graphic_elements.patterns: Subtle topographic map textures or route-lines in hero/dark sections at 5-10% opacity to reinforce the aerospace/navigation theme.

components.navigation: Sticky top-0 z-50. Desktop: Logo left, links center, CTA right. Mobile: Hamburger menu opening a full-screen drawer overlay. Links: Home, About, Activities, Cadets, Parents, Volunteer, FAQ, Join.
components.hero: Split layout or full-bleed aviation background. Use provided crest alongside the main RAF Air Cadets textual branding. CTA: 'Join Us' (RAF Red button). Must include an overlay to ensure text contrast (e.g. bg-[#071A2F]/60).
components.activities_grid: 12-card bento/interactive grid. Images (aircraft, skies) or bold typography for each card. Hover: Image scales slightly, title slides up.
components.feature_cards: Used for 'About', 'Parents', and 'Volunteer' sections. Strict alignment, left-aligned text, crisp lucide-react icons.
components.join_form: Shadcn UI form components. Strict validation. Input fields: Name, Email, Phone, Enquiry Type (select), Message (textarea), Consent (checkbox). Minimalist borders, focus:ring-[#002F5F].
components.faq_accordion: Clean, flat accordion. Active state changes title color to RAF Red. 1px bottom border for each item.

crest.description: 1471 Squadron Crest. Use as a supporting local mark (do not let it dominate over standard RAFAC branding).

hero_background.description: Glider aircraft flying under cloudy skies. Use in hero or activities sections to convey aviation/adventure. (Add dark overlay if text sits on top: bg-[#071A2F]/60).

texture_background.description: Topographic map lines texture. Use as a very subtle background layer (opacity-5 mix-blend-multiply) in light sections.

sky_background.description: Sea of clouds. Use for parallax or wide background sections (Qualifications/Value).

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, and key informational blocks MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="join-submit-button"`).

restrictions.faces: DO NOT use AI-generated cadet faces, fake uniforms, or any people photography. Rely on aviation silhouettes and typographic graphic panels.
restrictions.military_language: DO NOT use aggressive military recruitment language implying joining the Armed Forces. It is a youth organization.
restrictions.aircraft: DO NOT use distorted aircraft or bent glider wings.
restrictions.typography: DO NOT use generic Inter/Roboto for headings. Stick to the authoritative/display font.
restrictions.placeholders: DO NOT use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Use the provided media URLs.

data_content.venue: Mon and Thu 1900-2130, 1471 (Horwich) ATC Sqn HQ, St Josephs Secondary School & Sports College, Chorley New Road, Horwich, BL6 6HW

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement this design using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI (customize components for sharp edges and precise borders). Use standard Javascript (.js). Strictly follow the color hex codes. Use lucide-react for iconography. Build out all sections mentioned in the problem statement. Ensure responsiveness (mobile-first). Integrate framer-motion for smooth entrance animations on the cards and activities grid.
